info.title: Bond Pet Foods Content API (WordPress REST API)
info.description: The WordPress REST API (wp/v2) served from www.bondpets.com: posts, pages, media, categories, tags, comments, taxonomies, site search and the site's WooCommerce product post type. Collection reads are public; writes and most edit-context reads (users, settings) require authentication and return HTTP 401 anonymously. Derived from the site's own WordPress REST discovery index and per-route OPTIONS schemas.
info.x-derivation: Mechanically derived from the live WordPress REST API discovery index at https://www.bondpets.com/wp-json/ plus a per-route HTTP OPTIONS request against the same host, which returns each route's own JSON Schema. Paths, methods, parameter schemas and response schemas are the provider's own published values; none were authored by API Evangelist.
